'''Pax''' was a [[Planet|world]]<ref name="SkeletonCrew">{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}}</ref> located in the [[Pax system]] of the [[Kira sector]],<ref name="Appendix" /> a part of the [[Expansion Region]]<ref name="TFABG" /> and the [[Trailing Sectors]]<ref name="TrailingSectors" /> in grid square N-16 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. The [[Super-hyperroute|hyperspace route]] known as the [[Hydian Way]] linked it to the [[Chardaan system|Chardaan]] and [[ZeHeth system]]s<ref name="TFABG" /> while the [[Enarc Run]]<ref name="Enarc" /> connected it to [[Kira system|Kira]] and [[Vondarc system]]s.<ref name="TFABG" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="9 ABY">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> while the [[astronomer]]<ref name="DB Khymm">{{Databank|khymm|Kh'ymm}}</ref> [[Kh'ymm]] was searching her archive of worlds on the [[Observatory Moon]] in order to determine the potential location of the lost planet [[At Attin]], Pax's name was listed on her [[computer]] screen among other worlds.<ref name="SkeletonCrew" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pax's name was first mentioned in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the "[[Guide to the Galaxy]]" section of the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 43|fourty-third]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'' magazine,<ref name="BMF 43">{{BuildFalconCite|43|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> published around [[October 28]], [[2015]],<ref name="BMF43date">{{BMFdates|43}}</ref> and written by [[Mark Newbold]].<ref name="SM">{{DMCite|dm=File:MarkNewbold-CreditsBMF.png|creator=Mark Newbold}}</ref> Pax was first described as a distinct world in "[[Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem]],"<ref name="SkeletonCrew" /> the [[December 10]], [[2024]]<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1861409832349172011|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2024-11-26|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/uxgSx|archivefile=File:StarWars-SkeletonCrewSchedule-Twitter.png}}</ref> third episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]''.<ref name="InterestingEpGuide">{{SW|url=series/skeleton-crew/season-1-episode-3-episode-guide|text="Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem" Episode Guide | Star Wars: Skeleton Crew}}</ref>

The [[Pax system]] was originally introduced in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity via the [[1993]] book [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the book, the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] appeared in the [[roleplaying game]] adventure "[[Treasure Hunt (adventure)|Treasure Hunt]]," which was written by [[Todd Quigley]] and illustrated by [[Tim Eldred]].<ref name="TSoK">{{WEGCite|story=Treasure Hunt (adventure)|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref>
